description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Order No. 04/2022
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a legal/regulatory order made under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It establishes new customs exemption procedures for imported essential goods received as aid/donations, including specific regulatory requirements, approval processes, and compliance measures. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, the primary content is regulatory in nature - creating new legal procedures and requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
